name: voting-platform
description: Complete Online Voting Platform - Fullstack Web Application
author: Voting Platform Team

scripts.dev: concurrently "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd frontend && http-server -p 3000 -c-1"
scripts.build: echo 'Frontend is static - no build required'
scripts.db:reset: mysql -u root -p -e "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS voting_platform; CREATE DATABASE voting_platform;" && npm run db:setup
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && echo 'Setup complete! Run npm run db:setup to initialize database'
